name: all-documents-reader
description: All documents reader — an offline document reader/organizer web app, wrapped as an Android APK with Capacitor.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run bundle && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
